3

The diagram editor (diagram.html) draws flowcharts and other diagrams: shapes, connectors, text, images, several pages. It opens and saves draw.io files, so diagrams can be exchanged with draw.io (diagrams.net) and its desktop app, and it imports Excalidraw drawings.

Files

Format Open Save
draw.io (.drawio, .xml), also compressed yes, all pages yes (Save, Ctrl+S)
SVG and PNG with an embedded diagram (.drawio.svg, .drawio.png) yes SVG / PNG export
Excalidraw (.excalidraw) yes (rectangles, ellipses, diamonds, text, arrows, lines, images) –
Mermaid flowchart (.mmd, .mermaid) yes, laid out automatically –

The SVG and PNG exports show the current page as a picture and contain the whole diagram, like draw.io's "editable" exports: open them again in this editor (or in draw.io) to continue editing. Dropping a diagram file onto the window opens it; dropping an image inserts it.

🖨 prints the diagram: every page on its own sheet with its name, scaled to the width of the sheet. Choose "Save as PDF" as the printer to get a PDF.

draw.io has many more shapes and options. Shapes this editor does not know are shown as rectangles, and labels are plain text (bold or coloured parts of a label are not kept). Style settings that the editor does not use are kept when you save, so a round trip through this editor does not remove them.

Drawing

  • The shape bar on the left adds a shape in the middle of the view; you can also drag a shape onto the drawing.
  • Keyboard tools: R rectangle, O ellipse, D decision (diamond), N note, T text, A connector, V select, H pan. With a shape tool, drag to draw the shape in any size.
  • Connectors: point at a shape; small circles appear at the middle of each side. Drag from one of them to another shape (onto a circle for a fixed side, or anywhere on the shape for a floating end). Drag the end points of a selected connector to attach them elsewhere or to leave them free.
  • Text: double-click a shape or connector to edit its label (Ctrl+Enter or a click outside finishes, Escape cancels). Double-click on an empty place to add a text. F2 or Enter edits the selected item.
  • Images: the image button inserts a picture file; pasted and dropped images work too.

Shape libraries

Below the general shapes, further libraries open with a click on their name (the open ones are remembered):

Library Shapes
UML class, package, component, actor, use case (ellipse), note
BPMN task, start, intermediate and end event, exclusive gateway, pool, document, data store
Network server, computer, firewall, router, cloud, database
Entity relationship entity, relationship (diamond), attribute (ellipse)

Classes and entities have a title compartment: the first line of the text is the title, the further lines are listed below it, and a line with only -- draws a separator (e.g. between fields and methods). Connector ends (format panel, Start/End) include the crow's foot notation for entity relationships (er-one, er-mand-one, er-many, er-one-many, er-zero-one, er-zero-many) and the hollow triangle and diamond of UML (block-open for generalisation, diamond-open for aggregation). All of them are saved as the corresponding draw.io shapes and arrows.

Selecting and arranging

  • Click selects, Shift+click adds or removes, dragging on an empty place selects everything inside the frame, Ctrl+A selects all.
  • Drag to move (on the grid; hold Alt for free positioning), drag the handles to resize (Shift keeps the proportions). The arrow keys move by one point, with Shift by one grid step.
  • Delete removes the selection (connectors of removed shapes are removed too). Ctrl+D duplicates, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+X and Ctrl+V copy, cut and paste — also between this editor and draw.io, because the clipboard holds draw.io XML. Pasted plain text becomes a text.
  • Undo Ctrl+Z, redo Ctrl+Y (or Ctrl+Shift+Z).

Groups, locking and layers

  • Group (Ctrl+G, in the format panel) joins the selected shapes and connectors: a click on one of them selects the whole group, which then moves together; Alt+click selects a single member. Ungroup (Ctrl+Shift+G) separates them again.
  • Lock (Ctrl+L) fixes the selection: locked objects cannot be selected, moved or deleted by accident (clicks go through them). Unlock all in the Diagram panel (nothing selected) or Ctrl+Shift+L releases them.
  • Layers (in the Diagram panel, top layer first): ◉ chooses the layer new shapes go to, 👁 shows or hides a layer (hidden layers are not exported or printed either), 🔒 locks it, ▲ ▼ change the order, a double-click renames it, × deletes it (its content moves to the layer below), + Add layer adds one. With several layers, Move to layer in the format panel moves the selection.

Groups, locks and layers are saved in the draw.io file and are understood by draw.io.

Automatic layout and Mermaid

Automatic layout (in the format panel when nothing is selected – or with several shapes selected, for just those) arranges the shapes in layers along their connectors: top to bottom, left to right, bottom to top or right to left. Connectors pointing back against that direction are led around the side. Undo restores the previous arrangement.

Insert Mermaid… turns a Mermaid flowchart into shapes and connectors and lays them out, for example:

B{OK?} B -->|yes| C([Done]) B -- no --> D[(Database)] D -.-> A]]>

Supported are the direction (TD/TB, LR, BT, RL), the node shapes [ ] rectangle, ( ) rounded, ([ ]) terminator, [( )] cylinder, (( )) circle, { } decision, {{ }} hexagon, [/ /] parallelogram, quoted labels and <br>, the links -->, ---, -.-> (dashed), ==> (thick), <-->, --o, --x, labels as -->|text| or -- text -->, chains and A & B --> C. Subgraphs, styles and classes are ignored; other Mermaid diagram types (sequence, class, …) cannot be imported.

Format panel

The panel on the right shows the settings of the selection:

Section Settings
Style shape type, fill (or none), line colour (or none), line width, dashed, opacity
Connector routing (straight, elbow, curved), arrow at the start and at the end (none, classic, open, diamond, oval)
Text font size and colour, bold, italic, horizontal and vertical alignment
Position and size X, Y, width and height of a single shape
Arrange to front, to back, duplicate, delete; with several shapes: align left/centre/right/top/middle/bottom, distribute

Without a selection, the panel switches the grid and snapping on or off.

Pages and view

The bar at the bottom shows the pages: click to switch, double-click to rename, + adds a page, × deletes the current page. Ctrl + mouse wheel (or pinch) zooms, the mouse wheel scrolls, hold Space or use the hand tool to move the view. Fit (Ctrl+0) shows the whole page.

Keyboard shortcuts

On a Mac, use Cmd instead of Ctrl. F1 (or ?) shows this list in the application.

On phones and tablets

The shapes are in a bar below the drawing; tap one to add it. Format opens the format panel. Two fingers zoom and move the view.
